design: Prospective translation extraction of a retrospective selected advice cohort
adjudication: No discretionary adjudication. Report two originals, exact-quote validity, agreements and unions.
incomplete_review: Retain as unresolved. Never infer source failure from a missing annotation.

replay.source: Previously captured 30-family mathematical pilot, all families
replay.direct_projection: Both valid reviewers agree on P1/P2 resource and accuracy without filters, new items or seed dependence
replay.ambiguous_p1_p2_weights: Convex hull of the P1 and P2 resource gap endpoints
replay.precision: Exact rational finite-cohort bounds with missing correctness in [0,1]
replay.unit: Resource-induced cohort score projection. Full recommended statistical decisions require more outputs.
replay.seed_metrics: Require seed predictions; score projection alone must not be called full plan execution
replay.unsupported_resource: Separate missing replay bank from intrinsically unresolved source recipe

limitations: Prior primary advice ratings stay separate
Two model readers can share errors
